quality.review: No production authority or transport changes. Signed callbacks enter the owned server public HTTP interface; task grants and operations use public APIs. Store access is limited to trusted fixture enrollment and snapshot assertions. The callback helper is separate from the focused journey; no new public crate API is exposed.

behavior: Tampered callback is unauthorized and leaves Store unchanged. Valid duplicate STOP cancels queued dispatch with opted-out; HELP and STOP generate no assistant reply or provider-owned keyword acknowledgement.
START after server restart allows a new logical send while the original cancelled effect returns provider-failed. Replayed old STOP does not supersede newer START.
Exactly one loopback Telnyx API send occurs. Signed delivery and duplicate delivery retain one delivered job; delivery alone does not answer the waiting task.
Duplicate incoming SMS creates one unassigned reply in the existing conversation. Explicit owner assignment binds the actual question to one task; phone number and sender do not guess the task.
After a second owned-server restart, assignment replay retains one binding and source-backed recall returns the actual answer; sibling task is unchanged.
Task cancellation denies accepted-send replay with forbidden even after START. The original cancelled send stays cancelled.
Existing reviewed-purpose/route/lease/STOP dispatch failures and Vapi voice-decision-to-chat continuation also pass. These are separate checks, not a combined voice-to-SMS proof.

Initial behavior pass before tightening rejection assertions to exact application codes.
